import.title: Import Excel Data
import.subtitle: Import transactions from an Excel (.xlsx) file
import.rules_desc: Make sure the first row (header) of your Excel file matches the following column rules before uploading:
import.date_columns_rule: Date can be a single full date column (YYYY-MM-DD / DD/MM/YYYY) or 3 separate columns (Tanggal, Bulan, Tahun).
import.limits_rule: Format .xlsx, maximum 2 MB and 1,000 rows on the first sheet.
import.adjustment_guide_body: Rename 'Barang Yang Dibeli' to 'Deskripsi', rename 'Total Rp' to 'Nominal', remove 'Jumlah (barang)', and ensure 'Tipe' (Pemasukan/Pengeluaran) & 'Kategori' columns exist.
import.file_spec_format: Format & Structure: Must be .xlsx, only the first sheet is parsed, and row 1 must contain column headers.
import.file_spec_limits: Size & Row Limits: Maximum 2 MB compressed (20 MB uncompressed, max 100 ZIP entries), and up to 1,000 data rows and 10 columns.
import.file_spec_merged_warning: Cell Rules: Merged cells are STRICTLY NOT SUPPORTED. Formulas are permitted (their evaluated result is validated).
import.file_spec_ghost_rows_tip: Ghost Rows Warning: If 'Import limit exceeded' appears, ensure no formatted empty rows/columns exist. Select blank rows beneath your table and use 'Delete Rows' (not just the Delete key).
import.file_spec_rate_limit: Rate Limit: Up to 10 imports per hour.
import.col_tanggal_desc: 1 full date column (YYYY-MM-DD / DD/MM/YYYY / Excel date) OR 3 columns (Tanggal = 1-31, Bulan = 1-12/month name, Tahun = 4 digits). Cannot be in the future (WIB).
import.col_kategori_desc: Category name (max 50 characters). If not existing, choose 'Create new' or 'Assign to Other'.
import.col_deskripsi_desc: Header must exist in row 1, row cells may be empty (max 255 characters).
import.col_nominal_desc: Positive integer amount in IDR (> 0 up to 999,999,999,999). Allows 'Rp' text and thousand separators. Must not be item quantity.
import.col_ignored_desc: These columns can stay in the Excel file and will be ignored automatically.
import.template_downloaded: Excel template is ready to save/share
import.error_limit_exceeded_detail: File exceeds import limits: maximum 1,000 data rows, 10 columns, 2 MB (20 MB uncompressed), or 15-second parsing timeout.
import.error_ghost_rows_solution: Solution: If your actual rows are few, open Excel, select all empty rows below your data, right click > 'Delete Rows' to purge ghost formatted rows, and ensure no merged cells exist.
import.error_rate_limited_detail: You reached the limit of 10 imports per hour. Please wait a bit before trying again.
import.error_network_detail: Failed to connect to backend server or request timed out. Please check network connection and ensure file is valid.
import.header_mismatch_title: Column Names Do Not Match Rules
import.header_mismatch_desc: The file was rejected because the header row does not match the import specification. Please fix the following columns in your Excel file:
import.skip_duplicates_hint: Rows with identical date, type, amount, and description will not be imported twice.
import.notification_notice_desc: Batch imports do not trigger individual bell notifications for each imported transaction. Notifications are only triggered if an expense pushes a category budget to 90% or 100% (with monthly deduplication).
